character.name: Tera
character.desc: A debt collector. Uses <c=status>TAX</c> to damage enemies and <c=status>BAILOUT</c> to avoid negative statuses.

TeraTaxation.name: Tax
TeraTaxation.desc: Deals one damage to enemies per three <c=status>TAX</c> on the enemy.

TeraPersistence.name: Persistence
TeraPersistence.desc: Increase <c=status>TAX</c> by {0} at the start of turn.

AOverthink.title: Overthink
AOverthink.desc: Discard a <c=card>Ponder</c> in hand, or in the draw pile.

ExtractKnowledge.name: Extract Knowledge
ExtractKnowledge.descB: <c=attack>Attack {0}</c>. If it kills, gain a <c=cardtrait>non-temp</c> <c=card>Ponder B</c>.

BuriedKnowledge.name: BURIED KNOWLEDGE
BuriedKnowledge.desc: At the start of combat, add 3 <c=card>Ponder</c>s to the discard pile.

Lexicon.name: LEXICON
Lexicon.desc: Whenever you gain a <c=card>Ponder</c> during combat, it is given the A or B upgrade, alternating.
